Project & Portfolio Management

  • Lead cross-functional project teams across Brazil, Argentina and Colombia to deliver projects on time, within budget and to defined quality targets.
  • Manage a portfolio of product development and value-improvement projects, balancing innovation, productivity and regulatory/compliance needs.
  • Develop and track project plans, timelines, risk registers, mitigation actions and communication routines.

Provide regular updates to leadership on project status, risks, resource needs and key decisions.

Technical Excellence & Documentation

  • Ensure high-quality creation and maintenance of technical documentation (drawings, models, specs, test methods, engineering changes).
  • Develop and deploy best practices and standards for plastics design, tolerance stack-ups, GD&T, and drawing release processes.
  • Drive root cause analysis and problem solving (e.g., DMAIC, 8D, fishbone) for product- and process-related issues.
  • Support continuous improvement of testing and validation protocols to ensure compliance with safety, performance and regulatory standards.

People Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead, coach and develop a multi-country team of product engineers and project leaders, building strong technical and leadership capabilities.
  • Provide clear priorities, feedback and career development plans; model high standards of safety, ethics, accountability and collaboration.
  • Build training content and deliver sessions on core topics such as plastics design, DFM, technical drawings, and project management.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and customer focus across the engineering and plant teams.

Strategic Alignment & Stakeholder Management

  • Align product development roadmap with category strategies (Home Appliances, Outdoor & Recreation, Baby and Commercial Products) and with plant capabilities.
  • Work closely with Marketing, Category, Finance and Sourcing to define product requirements, target costs, value propositions and business cases.
  • Ensure projects and engineering priorities are clearly linked to business objectives, productivity targets and PEAK/Continuous Improvement initiatives.
  • Represent LATAM plants in global technical forums, sharing best practices and leveraging global knowledge and standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Plastics, Materials, Manufacturing or related field).
  • Significant experience in product development for manufactured goods, with strong exposure to plastics and high-volume production.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional projects and timelines in a manufacturing environment.
  • Hands-on experience with technical drawings and GD&T (creating, reviewing and approving 2D drawings and 3D models).
  • Proven team management or people-leadership experience (direct or project-based), including mentoring and developing engineers.
  • Experience working in an organization with a Continuous Improvement methodology (TPM, Lean, Six Sigma, PEAK or equivalent).
  • Fluent English
  • Up to 60–70% travel to plants and offices across LATAM (Brazil, Argentina, Colombia) and periodically to North America.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in Engineering, Product Development, or Business (MBA).
  • Experience in at least one of the target categories: Home Appliances, Outdoor & Recreation, Baby Products or Commercial Products.
  • Direct experience with plastics tooling and mold development (injection molds, prototyping tools, etc.).
  • Formal Project Management training/certification (e.g., PMP, Prince2).
  • Experience in multi-country, matrixed organizations.
  • Fluent Spanish

Skills & Abilities

  • Strong technical foundation in plastics, product design and manufacturing processes.
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to work seamlessly from the shop floor to senior leadership, building credibility at all levels of the organization.
  • Strong leadership skills: able to motivate, engage and develop people across different sites and cultures.
  • Outstanding communication, influencing and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Analytical and data-driven mindset, with strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
  • Well organized, disciplined in time management and follow-through.
  • Open-minded, adaptable and comfortable leading changes in dynamic environments.

Newell Brands (NASDAQ: NWL) is a leading global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well-known brands, including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Rubbermaid Commercial Products, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, FoodSaver, Dymo, EXPO, Elmer’s, Oster, NUK, Spontex and Campingaz. We are focused on delighting consumers by lighting up everyday moments.

title: Process Specialist
description:
About the Company:

Munksjö is a leading international manufacturer of decorative papers for coating wood-based panel surfaces. Our mission is to create comfortable living and working environments, and taking responsibility for the future of our planet is our top priority.

We develop and offer innovative and customized solutions in decorative papers, which after additional processing are used in the production of furniture, laminate flooring, and surface materials for both indoor and outdoor applications.

We are looking for a Process Specialist to join our team. This professional will play a strategic role in analyzing indicators, identifying improvement opportunities, and leading initiatives focused on productivity, quality, and operational efficiency.   • Collaborate with the Project Engineering team in the implementation of improvements and innovations in plant processes.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Production Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields;
  • Experience in industrial processes, preferably in the pulp and paper sector;
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement tools (Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, etc.);
  • Analytical, proactive profile with strong teamwork skills in multidisciplinary environments;

Other Requirements:

  • Experience with energy efficiency, sustainability projects, or reduction of natural resource consumption;
  • Previous experience in bleaching, drying, refining, or pulp preparation processes;
  • Familiarity with automation and industrial process control systems;

description:
Job Title: Head of Sales (Sales Manager)

Department: Sales

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

Location: Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Brazil

Employment Type: Full-Time, CLT ou PJ

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on, results-driven Head of Sales to lead and scale our commercial operations in Brazil. This is both a strategic and operational role, ideal for someone who can design sales strategies and execute them personally.

You will be working in a startup environment, not a corporate structure. This means high autonomy, fast decision-making, direct customer contact, and the flexibility to step outside your job title when needed. In addition to defining the sales strategy, you will be actively involved in prospecting, client visits, negotiations, and closing deals.

This role is critical to the company’s growth. You will have a direct impact on revenue generation, team building, and the development of scalable sales processes as the company expands.

Key Responsibilities Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth
  • Develop, implement, and continuously optimize clear, measurable sales strategies
  • Define priorities by region, product, and customer segment
  • Actively drive revenue through calls, on-site visits, and negotiations
  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities
  • Adapt strategies quickly based on real-world market feedback
Field Sales Execution
  • Personally visit clients and prospects when required
  • Open new accounts through cold outreach and door-to-door visits
  • Support and close strategic and high-value negotiations
  • Represent the company professionally in the field
Team Leadership & Coordination
  • Coordinate daily with internal sales reps, freelancers, and partners
  • Set targets, KPIs, and execution plans
  • Lead from the front with active selling and field presence
  • Train, motivate, and hold the team accountable for results
CRM, Processes & Reporting
  • Work in a structured manner with the CRM system (HubSpot is essential)
  • Monitor pipeline, conversion rates, ticket size, and individual performance
  • Report results, forecasts, and action plans to management
  • Ensure sales activities align with operational and logistical capacity
Startup & Operational Support
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced startup with changing priorities
  • Understand core operational and logistical processes to support sales execution

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Infraestrutura SAP Júnior para atuar no suporte e gestão das demandas técnicas relacionadas às aplicações SAP do cliente. A posição é ideal para profissionais em início de carreira em infraestrutura, com base generalista em TI e forte interesse em aprender e se desenvolver em ambiente corporativo de grande porte.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar no atendimento e gestão de chamados das aplicações SAP , acompanhando as demandas do início ao fim.
  • Realizar a gestão das demandas de infraestrutura SAP em diferentes ambientes (desenvolvimento, qualidade, produção).
  • Apoiar o monitoramento da performance da aplicação SAP , incluindo aspectos básicos de rede, servidores e cloud.
  • Atuar sobre aproximadamente 20 a 30 servidores SAP distribuídos entre ambientes.
  • Interagir com parceiros externos para investigação e resolução de incidentes.
  • Participar de forma pontual em temas funcionais, quando necessário, sempre com foco na solução do problema.
  • Registrar, acompanhar e organizar demandas utilizando ferramentas como ServiceNow, Jira e Power Automate .
  • Garantir comunicação clara com as áreas envolvidas, mantendo o controle e o acompanhamento das solicitações até a resolução.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Conhecimento generalista em TI;
  • Conceitos básicos de banco de dados;
  • Sistemas operacionais de servidores;
  • Noções básicas de redes;
  • Interesse em atuar com aplicações SAP , mesmo sem experiência prévia em infraestrutura SAP.
  • Perfil proativo, colaborativo e com forte vontade de aprender .
  • Capacidade de buscar soluções, envolver os parceiros corretos e acompanhar demandas até a resolução.
  • Boa organização para gestão de múltiplas demandas simultâneas.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento ou vivência em SAP Basis .
  • Noções de cloud .
  • Experiência prévia com ServiceNow, Jira ou Power Automate .
  • Inglês para leitura e comunicação básica (não obrigatório).

title: SDR (Pré-Vendas)

  • Autonomia, protagonismo e um forte senso de dono.
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e empática, com habilidade para construir rapport.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados do funil e identificar tendências.

title: Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure
description:
Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure

Location: Remote; travel within-country

Sector: Modular Data Center Infrastructure (AI & HPC)

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

About MatraVolt

MatraVolt is a deep-tech company building next-generation prefabricated infrastructure for the AI era. Our multi-module architecture enables high-density, liquid-cooled deployments with radically faster delivery, lower on-site risk, and superior total cost. The solution has been adopted by the one of the world’s largest AI data center project in the United States and we are now scaling across EU and Latin America with colocation providers, hyperscale developers, EPCs, and energy-conscious AI platforms.

Role Summary

We’re hiring a Country Head at MD level to drive MatraVolt’s go-to-market and commercial outcomes. You will build and convert a country-level pipeline with colocation operators, hyperscalers, developers/EPCs, and other players in the ecosystem, form strategic partnerships, and orchestrate complex, technical deals - positioning MatraVolt as the default choice for next-gen AI/HPC infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities
  • Market development: map priority accounts (colo, hyperscale, BTS developers, EPC/SIs, utilities/energy partners), create multi-threaded entry, and land flagship wins.
  • Enterprise sales: qualify, shape requirements, lead solutioning with engineering (high-density racks, liquid cooling, modular power/cooling blocks).
  • Partnerships & routes-to-market: establish and manage EPC / SI / channel alliances and project-specific consortiums.
  • Program leadership: drive country bids/RFPs; coordinate delivery timelines and site readiness with Operations.
  • Intelligence & feedback: provide structured market signals (customer pain, regulatory/power constraints, competitive moves) to sharpen product, pricing, and delivery playbooks.
  • Governance & risk: ensure compliance with customer, HSE, and site policies.
Ideal Profile
  • 5+ years in enterprise data center / critical infrastructure sales or BD.
  • Credible network among colocation buyers and AI/HPC stakeholders; comfortable at C-suite, engineering, and procurement levels.
  • Fluency in technical value: high-density GPU environments, liquid cooling, modular power & cooling blocks, prefabrication/off-site integration, and time-to-live economics.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on operator who can open doors, design the deal at startup pace.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese/Spanish and Fluent English
Contract Details
  • Type: Contractor / Independent Consultant
  • Compensation: Monthly travel allowance + uncapped, highly competitive success-based commission
  • Start: Immediate
Why Join MatraVolt
  • Scale a solution already validated by the largest AI data center deployment globally.
  • Work where deep-tech, energy, and AI compute converge—on real projects, fast.
  • High autonomy, tight engineering partnership, and a product that wins on speed and cost.
  • Shape the country playbook and help define how Latin America builds AI infrastructure.
